messages:
Gina: Heads up 1: did a quick walkthrough of the Private setup wizard. The "Connectivity" step is intimidating for non-network folks. Can we make it friendlier?
Marco: Agree. Proposed: show a compact outcome banner first (Passed / Action required) and hide raw logs behind a collapse.
Ivy: Copy: change vague labels like 'Network error' to something actionable: 'Cannot reach agent on port 8080 1: open firewall or enable port forwarding.' Short + direct.
Samir: For CIDR overlaps, provide a 'Suggest alternative range' button that proposes a non-conflicting CIDR. Show a preview and require explicit accept.
preflight-bot: preflight complete: 4 checks run, 1 blocking failure, 1 warning.
Gina: Accessibility: when a blocking failure appears, move keyboard focus to the banner and use aria-live="assertive" to announce it. Also include a textual status badge (Passed/Failed).
Marco: UI behavior: per-check rows should have icon, title, status chip, and two inline actions: 'Re-run' (async) and 'Help'. Default help collapsed.
Ivy: Keep developer snippets but hide by default. Example:```bash
# check from bastion
curl -sS http://<ip>:8080/health
```Make copy-to-clipboard obvious.
Samir: For warnings, show an amber banner and a 'Proceed with caution' link that opens a modal explaining tradeoffs and asks for confirmation with a checkbox.
Gina: Mobile: render only the banner + primary CTA; expand details on tap.
Marco: Microcopy tweak: rename 'Failed checks' -> 'Action needed' and surface the single most important fix at the top. Less signal/noise.
Ivy: For replay tests, stream per-check status (small spinner and final pass/fail text) rather than a full-page spinner. Use polite aria-live for progress updates.
preflight-bot: note: re-runs are rate-limited (3 attempts per 5m).
Samir: For the suggested CIDR helper, add an 'Example' tooltip showing why a range conflicts (brief sentence) and a KB link for cloud SG examples.
Gina: Also add a 'Download report' (tiny JSON) button for ops to attach to tickets. Keep the file lightweight.
Marco: I'll mock the per-row controls and suggest strings. Ivy, can you add the CLI snippets and the copy-to-clipboard affordance?
Ivy: Yep, will do. Also will mark all interactive elements with focus styles for keyboard users.
Gina: Thanks all 1: I'll post Figma frames and label a11y items. Review next Tue.
